title: Extended passive voice
theme: Passive voice expanded (modal passives, future passive, by + agent, get + past participle)
goal: Student handles passive in all common forms — modal, future, with agent, and the informal "get" passive.
connects_to: M17 (Reported speech) — shift from passive to backshift narrative.
module_chunks: must be done / can be seen (modal passive)
has to be finished / should be sent
will be delivered / will be announced
get + past participle (got hurt, get married)

units.title: It must be done
units.real_life_context: You give instructions, state requirements, or speculate about what can/must/should be done.

grammar.explanation: Modal passive = "modal + be + past participle". "Must be finished" — obrigação no recipient (relatório).
"Should be cleaned" — recomendação passive. Foco na sala.
Instrução formal: "must be filled" — modal passive padrão.
Plural "files" + obrigação → "have to be reviewed". Modal-like passive.

grammar.sentence: The car _____ if it makes that sound.
grammar.explanation: "Should be checked" — recomendação passive sobre o carro.
"Shouldn't be left unsupervised" — proibição passive.

grammar.sentence: The package _____ at this point — it's been weeks.
grammar.explanation: "Must have been lost" — modal perfect passive. Inferência forte sobre o passado em passive.

grammar.sentence: The report must finished by Friday.
grammar.answer: The report must be finished by Friday.
grammar.explanation: Modal passive sempre "modal + BE + past participle". "Must finished" não funciona.
"Shouldn't BE left" — modal + be + past participle. Forma fixa.

grammar.passage: The report must be finished by Friday. This room should be cleaned every day. Children shouldn't be left alone. The form must be filled in blue ink.
grammar.question: How must the form be filled?
grammar.explanation: The text says "The form must be filled in blue ink".

listening_speaking.text: The report must be finished by Friday.
This must be done carefully.
Children shouldn't be left alone.
The form should be filled in blue ink.
These files have to be reviewed.

units.title: It will be done
units.grammar_focus: Future passive (will be + past participle; is going to be + past participle)
units.real_life_context: You announce upcoming events or planned actions where the recipient matters more than the agent.

grammar.explanation: Future passive = "will be + past participle". "Will be announced" — foco no vencedor, não em quem anuncia.
"Will be sent" — future passive plural. "Sent" é past participle de "send".
"Is going to be released" — future plan passive. Estrutura: "to be going to + be + past participle".
Future passive de delivery. "Will be delivered tomorrow morning".
"Will be served at 7" — future passive padrão.
"Will be completed" — future passive sobre obra.

grammar.hint: is going to be + past participle "hold"
grammar.explanation: "Is going to be held" — futuro planejado passive. "Hold" → past participle "held".

grammar.answer: The winner will be announced tomorrow.
grammar.explanation: Future passive sempre "will BE + past participle". "Will announced" não existe.

grammar.sentence: The package will be deliver tomorrow.
grammar.answer: The package will be delivered tomorrow.
grammar.explanation: Após "will be" sempre past participle, não base form. "Deliver" → "delivered".

grammar.passage: The winner will be announced tomorrow. The results will be sent by email next week. The new album is going to be released next month. Dinner will be served at 7 PM.
grammar.question: When will dinner be served?
grammar.explanation: The text says "Dinner will be served at 7 PM".

listening_speaking.text: The winner will be announced tomorrow.
The package will be delivered Monday.
Dinner will be served at 7.
The new album is going to be released.
Results will be emailed.

units.title: By the artist
units.grammar_focus: Passive with "by + agent" — when to include and when to omit
units.real_life_context: You credit the agent in passive when relevant; omit when generic or unimportant.

grammar.sentence: The Mona Lisa was painted _____ Leonardo.
grammar.explanation: Em passive, o agente é introduzido por "by". "By Leonardo" = quem fez a ação. Preposição fixa.

grammar.sentence: The novel _____ by a Brazilian writer.
grammar.explanation: Passive past + "by + agent". "Was written by a Brazilian writer".

grammar.sentence: The song _____ by my favorite artist.
grammar.explanation: "Was performed by..." — passive past com agente.
"Was made by my mother" — passive past + agent.
"By Spielberg" — preposição padrão do agente em passive.
"Was written by Shakespeare" — passive + agent famoso.
Plural "photos" → "were taken by my dad". Take → taken.

grammar.sentence: The Mona Lisa was painted from Leonardo.
grammar.answer: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo.
grammar.explanation: "From" indica origem/source. Para AGENTE de passive, sempre "by".

grammar.sentence: English is spoken by many countries.
grammar.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
grammar.explanation: "Countries" são LUGARES, não agentes. Use "in", não "by". "By" só para quem realiza a ação.

grammar.passage: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci. The novel was written by a famous Brazilian author. These photos were taken by my dad on vacation. The film was directed by Spielberg.
grammar.question: Who directed the film?
grammar.explanation: The text says "The film was directed by Spielberg".

listening_speaking.text: It was painted by Leonardo.
The book was written by my favorite author.
These photos were taken by my dad.
The cake was made by my mother.
The song was performed by a new band.

units.title: Get + past participle
units.grammar_focus: "Get" passive (got hurt, got married, get done) — informal alternative to "be"
units.real_life_context: You describe accidents, changes of state, or informal events with the "get + past participle" structure.

grammar.sentence: She _____ in a car accident last week.
grammar.explanation: "Get + past participle" = passive informal, especialmente para mudanças de estado ou acidentes. "Got hurt" — comum em fala.
"Got married" — chunk fixo. "Get" passive é muito usado para eventos de vida.

grammar.sentence: He _____ for the company last month.
grammar.explanation: "Got hired" — informal alternative para "was hired". Comum em fala.
"Get wet" — mudança de estado. "Get + adjective" também funciona como passive informal.
"Got stolen" — passive informal de "was stolen". Comum em narrativa.
"Got engaged" — evento de vida em get passive.
"Got lost" — comum em narrativa. "Lose" → past participle "lost".
"Last summer" indica passado. Use "got", não "get".

grammar.hint: Precisa past participle, não base form
grammar.explanation: Após "got", past participle. "Steal" → "stolen". "Got steal" não é gramatical.

grammar.passage: She got hurt in a car accident last week. They got married last summer in Italy. He got hired by a big tech company last month. My phone got stolen on the bus yesterday.
grammar.question: Where did they get married?
grammar.explanation: The text says "They got married last summer in Italy".

listening_speaking.text: She got hurt in the accident.
They got married last year.
I got lost in the city.
He got hired last month.
My phone got stolen.

units.title: All passives expanded
units.grammar_focus: Integration of modal passive, future passive, agent passive, get passive
units.real_life_context: You mix passive forms fluidly across registers (formal modal/future, informal get).

grammar.explanation: Instrução formal → modal passive. "Must be filled" — obrigação.
Anúncio formal futuro → future passive. "Will be announced".
Past simple passive + agente. "Was painted by Leonardo".
"Got married" — chunk informal de evento de vida.
Modal passive recomendação. "Should be cleaned".
Future passive. "Will be delivered tomorrow".
Get passive narrativo. "Got lost in the city".

grammar.sentence: The report must finished by Friday.
grammar.answer: The report must be finished by Friday.
grammar.explanation: Modal passive sempre "modal + BE + past participle".

grammar.sentence: The novel was wrote by a Brazilian author.
grammar.answer: The novel was written by a Brazilian author.
grammar.explanation: Verbo irregular: write → wrote (past simple) → written (past participle). Passive usa past participle.

grammar.passage: The report must be finished by Friday. The results will be announced tomorrow. The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo. She got married last weekend. This room should be cleaned daily.
grammar.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
grammar.explanation: The text says "The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo".

listening_speaking.text: The form must be filled in blue ink.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo.
She got married last weekend.
The bridge is going to be completed in 2030.
